unavailable_fields.per_collective_wire_transfer_ms: No available collector separates NCCL in-kernel waiting from wire transfer; torch kernel durations include device waiting and nsys timelines cannot split them either.
unavailable_fields.per_collective_interconnect_bytes: device_telemetry samples device-wide NVML PCIe/NVLink rates with native sampling windows, not per-collective bytes; logical payload sizes (28351488 B x12, 157541376 B x1) are not observed traffic and must not be converted into bandwidth estimates.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion_bo: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for CPU-to-CUDA submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown.
unavailable_fields.communication_lower_bound_or_critical_pa: collective_calibration is a synthetic warmed reference experiment with correctness checks, not a performance lower bound or model critical-path estimate.
unavailable_fields.bucket_identity_for_unmatched_payloads: Exact bucket links require native correlation plus observed gradient-storage membership; only the 13 matched allreduces have observed attribution in the parent trace, so no further bucket fields are requested.

plan.rationale: The only listed candidate 4de2b44c... (bundle trial-df7761708a-param-1931c00b, empty parameters, additive direct binding with 'no functional replacements', declared routes eager_parent_warmup + setup_fallback_eager, framework_fallbacks=0) reduced max-rank communication_kernel_sum_ms (74.68->63.60 rank0, 64.15->64.01 rank1 vs original reference) but failed the step_ms constraint (139.370 vs 138.660 limit, ~0.5% over), yielding no_valid_parameter_candidate; it also shows a much larger allocator footprint (reserved 3.24GB vs 2.10GB). The observed uncertainty is therefore attribution, not communication volume: (1) whether the step regression is additive binding/host overhead rather than algorithm cost -> binding_cost runs clean AB/BA parent vs binding-only passthrough on this exact additive candidate (applicable since no functional replacements exist; whole-invocation cost, no per-group effects); (2) whether the candidate-declared setup_fallback_eager route reflects actual behavior -> candidate_diagnostics for independent route/exception corroboration, since coverage route labels are candidate-reported telemetry and reference invocations are not proof of fallback; (3) where the extra ~7ms step time sits and why rank0/rank1 kernel sums were asymmetric (in-kernel waiting skew) -> execution_timeline CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, per-device intervals and sync points; (4) which NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel the warmed tuner actually chose at the observed sizes (12x 28,351,488B + 1x 157,541,376B f32 SUM, world 2) -> nccl_tuning, because kernel entry names alone (all RING_LL, ~3.26ms and ~19.4ms) do not establish the protocol and a 157MB LL choice would be anomalous; (5) warmed isolated reference durations at exactly these sizes/dtypes -> collective_calibration, to separate intrinsic collective cost from in-step waiting without treating it as a lower bound or critical path. Excluded: torch (already ran, provides the kernel timeline and natively observed bucket attribution); nsys (no open overlap, graph-tracing or bucket-attribution question - bucket identity is already observed gradient-storage membership plus matched parameter inventory); python_runtime (perturbs execution and its cProfile times are not clean scores; binding_cost already isolates binding overhead cleanly); device_telemetry (device-wide readings with native windows cannot attribute per-collective traffic and no topology question is open).
